trap.label: if + would have
trap.wrong: If the council would have invested, it would still be open.
trap.right: If the council had invested, it would still be open.
trap.why: O brasileiro traduz “se tivesse investido” com would have. Na oração com if use past perfect.

mcq.q: “___ the sample been larger, we would trust it.”

fix.wrong: If the council would have invested, it would still be open.
fix.right: If the council had invested, it would still be open.

fix.wrong: The woman whose her research is new spoke.
fix.right: The woman whose research is new spoke.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com inversão: “If I were you, I would sign.” (Were…)
rewrite.answer: Were I you, I would sign.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com account for: “Two firms explain most losses.”
rewrite.answer: Two firms account for most losses.

rewrite.prompt: Una com whose: “The town was flooded. Its mayor resigned.” (The town whose…)
rewrite.answer: The town whose mayor resigned was flooded.
